title: Hlompho
author: Lumni
content:
# Hlompho

Motseng o monyenyane oa Lithoteng, ho ne ho na le ngoana e motle ea bitsoang Mpho. Mpho o ne a tseba hore ho hlompha ba bang ke ntho ea bohlokoa. E ne e le ngoana ea kollang, a lumelisa batho ba baholo ka tlhompho.

Ngoana e mong oa sekolong, ea bitsoang Karabo, o ne a tseba ho se hlomphe. O ne a sa lumelise batho ba baholo, a sa mamele ha baruti ba bua, a bile a hlekefetsa ba bang.

Ka letsatsi le leng, Karabo o ile a utsoa pene ea Mpho. Eaba Mpho o re: "Karabo, ke tseba hore u nkile pene ea ka. Ke kopa u nkutloe le hlompho — u e nketse hantle, ke tla u tšoarela."

Karabo o ile a makala. O ne a lebelletse hore Mpho o tla koma mokhosi. Empa Mpho o ile a mo sebetsa ka mosa.

Bosiung boo, Ntate Moholo oa Karabo o ile a bua le eena. "Karabo, hlompho ke letsoai la bophelo. Ha u na hlompho, u joalo ka dijo tse se nang letsoai — ha li latsoehe."

Karabo o ile a lla. A hlokomela hore o entse phoso. Hoseng, o ile a khutlisetsa pene ea Mpho mme a kopa tšoarelo.

Mpho o ile a mo tšoarela ka thabo. Ho tloha ka letsatsi leo, Karabo o ile a qala ho fetoha. A lumelisa batho ka tlhompho, a mamela baruti le batsamaisi.

## Lintlha tša Thuto

1. **Hlompho** — Ho hlompha ba bang ho bontša hore u na le seriti le tlhompho.
2. **Tšoarelo** — Ho tšoarela ba re foselitseng ho bontša boholo ba pelo.
3. **Phetoho** — Ha re hlokomela liphoso tsa rona, re ka fetoha le ho ba batho ba betere.

## Mantswe a Maemo

vocabulary.definition: Respect; showing honour and high regard for others
Forgiveness; letting go of anger towards someone who wronged you
To return something to its owner or place
Kindness; gentle and caring behaviour towards others
Behaviour; the way a person acts or conducts themselves
